name: Raspberry Pi Pico
description: RP2040 (Cortex-M0+ @ 125 MHz, 264 KB RAM, 2 MB flash), 3.3 V I/O. Code in Arduino C++ (arduino-pico core) or MicroPython. Serial is the USB serial port; Serial1 is GP0/GP1, Serial2 GP8/GP9; Wire on GP4/GP5; SPI on GP16-19; ADC on GP26-28. Emulated by rp2040js (core 0 only).

micropython.template:
from machine import Pin
import time

led = Pin(25, Pin.OUT)  # the on-board LED
print("Hello from MicroPython!")

while True:
    led.toggle()
    time.sleep(0.5)
